title: Neonicotinoid pesticide residues in bottled water: a worldwide assessment of distribution and human exposure risks
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00813H, Paper
Yuanchen Chen, Ruirui Meng, Gege Liu, Wenfei Yu, Hangbiao Jin
Neonicotinoids were detected in bottled water worldwide, with the highest levels in Asia—particularly in purified water and during dry seasons—while infants had the highest exposure but remained below safety limits.
